source.disclaimer: This is an unofficial fan tool. Game names, images and other materials belong to their respective owners (HoYoverse). No warranty.
source.storage: Teams and rotations are stored only in your browser (localStorage). Team data is never sent to a server (gcsim also runs in your browser). Before clearing browser data or moving to another browser or device, save with "Export all data" in Rotations.
source.analytics: Visits are counted with Cloudflare Web Analytics (no cookies). Only access information such as the page URL and browser type is sent; team and settings data are not.

update.title: Master data has been updated
update.intro: An app update changed the bundled master data (characters, weapons, artifacts). The master data saved in this browser may be out of date. Update it with the following steps.
update.step2: Press "Generate latest data online (characters, weapons, artifacts)" at the top right (characters, weapons and artifacts are overwritten with the latest master data, in that order).
update.step3: When the completion message appears, close the Database.
update.noteLocked: ・Locked characters, weapons and artifacts, and entries you created, are not deleted.
update.noteRotations: ・Your rotations (saved and current) are kept. To be safe, first export a backup of all data from "Rotations → JSON backup & share".
update.closeTitle: Do not show again for this master data version
